Q: Good morning. This is the adjuster following up on the claim you reported. Is it all right if I record this statement?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please state where you were when the collision happened.
A: I was driving on the frontage road in League City, Texas, heading toward the main highway. I was in the right lane
and needed to move left to get over for my exit.
Q: Walk me through what you did before you changed lanes.
A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. I saw a vehicle a fair distance back, or so I thought. I put on my
turn signal and started to move over.
Q: What happened next?
A: The other car was closer than I realized. It came up beside me and we made contact along the passenger side of
my car. There was a loud scrape and my car pushed slightly toward the curb before I got it stopped.
Q: Were you injured at the scene?
A: Not right away. I felt fine for the first few minutes, but by the evening my neck was stiff and my lower back was
sore. The next morning it was worse, and I had trouble turning my head to check traffic.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the following day. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me muscle
relaxers and a referral to physical therapy. I have been going to therapy twice a week since then.
Q: Do you have any prior injuries to your neck or back?
A: I had some stiffness years ago from sleeping wrong, but nothing that required treatment or time off work.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to make sure my medical bills are handled properly.
Q: Thank you. We will be in touch with next steps. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
